about: Words shared by every client for editing an automation, its Failed group and the live line of a run in progress. Canonical copy: abstractuic ui-kit/src/automations/automation_edit_words.json; clients that cannot import the kit vendor it byte for byte. Schedule words (kinds, days, time zone line) stay in automation_controls.json.
